directive.thread_id: launch-video port 2026-11-05: the Whisper engine chooser many film scripts import
directive.quote: Finish the source-repo-a port so the repository can be retired: move whisper_here.py, the drop-in for mlx_whisper.transcribe that picks whichever Whisper engine the place has, into the Workshop tool that owns Whisper transcription, with every behaviour and test ported.

targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: whisper_here, the Whisper engine chooser, moved byte for byte

preserve: a drop-in for mlx_whisper.transcribe(path, path_or_hf_repo=..., **options) that answers mlx_whisper's shape from every engine, and says which engine made it in result["engine"]

WHISPER_BACKEND=mlx|faster|openai picks one; an unknown one is refused with the ones to use; otherwise the first that imports, in the order mlx, faster, openai; a place with none is told what to install
the model name is mapped from an mlx-community repo to the plain Whisper name for faster-whisper and openai-whisper
verbose is dropped; mlx gets every other option; the other engines get only the options they take; a temperature tuple becomes a list for faster-whisper
faster-whisper's segments carry words only when word times were asked; its device is WHISPER_DEVICE, else auto
allowed_deltas: the docstring points at this folder's README.md instead of the launch-video repository's docs/decouple-sweep.md
banned_substitutions: an engine picked by the operating system's name instead of by what imports
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
